name: Agent evaluators (IntentResolution / TaskAdherence / ToolCallAccuracy)
summary: azure-ai-evaluation agent-quality evaluators with a BYOM-prefixed judge model.
description: The agent-quality evaluators (`IntentResolutionEvaluator`, `TaskAdherenceEvaluator`, `ToolCallAccuracyEvaluator`, `ResponseCompletenessEvaluator`) take `model_config.azure_deployment` for the judge LLM. That deployment slot would need to accept `{connection}/{deployment}` to score agent traces with a BYOM-routed judge model.
notes:
BYOM is blocked by the eval SDK URL-shape bug. See `test.py`.

> `azure-ai-evaluation` constructs `/openai/deployments/{apim-conn}/{model}/chat/completions`, which Foundry does not route, so the server returns `400 'API version not supported'`.
